posts.author: Leonartoides
posts.body: how do people make 32*16 or generally small sprites look decently big on rpg maker xp?? Like in pokemon essentials or stardew valley pack

posts.author: alice_gristle
posts.body:
Hi sweetie!
I use MV to make 8-bit style games, and I just 3x upscale my 16x16 sprites to fit MV's 48x48 standard. XP uses 32x32 tiles, right? For that, I'd just 2x upscale!
